meta.name: Ensure Kubernetes Cluster is created with Private cluster enabled
meta.description: Ensure Kubernetes Cluster is created with Private cluster enabled

evaluators.description: google_container_cluster must declare a private_cluster_config block. In the plan the block is a list, so IsNotEmpty rejects both the empty list produced when the block is omitted and the null terraform writes when the computed block is unknown; an absent key is a severity-2 miss and also fails at error_tolerance 1.
